_note: Copy to league/hockey-league.json. id and teamId may stay blank when .env sets ESPN_SPORT=fhl with ESPN_LEAGUE_ID and ESPN_TEAM_ID. season is the year the NHL season ENDS (2027 for 2026-27). Every other value here is a placeholder: run node tools/nhl-league-verify.mjs, which prints ESPN's live value for every field that does not match, and copy those in. Then node tools/nhl-scoring-verify.mjs proves scoring.byStatId against ESPN's own totals. For a roto or categories league, replace byStatId with categories: { skater: [{ statId, direction }], goalie: [...] }, direction 1 for more is better and -1 for less is better.
